messages:
celeste: FYI - we're seeing an increase in embed tail latency and sporadic 502s in eu-west1 after the overnight quant push. small customer reports.
celeste: impact looks concentrated on sequences >1500 tokens, p99 up ~35%, error-rate +0.4%.
hank: can you link the dashboard and one failing request id?
celeste: dashboard https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-west1 example req id=R-44122 shows timeout at step 3.
oncall_sre: we need an expedited mitigation: owner, rollback command, staged plan, abort criteria, and a short changelog note.
hank: I can own the run. propose pin image embed-service:v2.2.5-stable for eu-west1 only and temporarily lower batch max to 32. rollout: 0.25% -> 2% -> 20% -> 100% with manual gates.
devrel: draft changelog line: 
```
Hotfix (expedited): revert embed model in eu-west1 from v2.3.5-quant to v2.2.5-stable and reduce batch max to 32 to mitigate p99 tail latency and intermittent 502s on long-sequence requests.
```
ops_lead: ensure CS and billing tags are added. alerting policy must be bumped to high-fidelity for canary slices.
oncall_sre: abort criteria: 5xx > 0.6% OR p99 regresses > 20% for 5m OR golden-set quality drop > 8% sustained 10m OR error-budget burn rate > 2x.
hank: deploybot, start hotpatch: service=embed-service region=eu-west1 from=v2.3.5-quant to=v2.2.5-stable owner=hank tag=hotfix-fastlane
deploybot: @hank scheduled deploy id=dr-1785556789-f. strategy=staged-canary slices=[0.25%,2%,20%,100%]; checks=[health, p95,p99,5xx,golden-set]; manual approval between stages.
ops_lead: infra ok for tiny initial slice; enabling extra trace logs and sampling for the canary slice.
hank: 0.25% canary starting now. log: dr-1785556789-f canary-start.
oncall_sre: monitoring, increased logging on canary. will hold 10m before approving next step.
hank: 8m update: p95 -15%, p99 -28% in canary, 5xx stable. golden-set metric improved 6%. requesting move to 2%.
oncall_sre: approve 2% step. still watch golden-set and error budget closely.
deploybot: progressing to 2% slice.
devrel: posting internal status note and tagging CS "expedited-hotfix".
hank: 12m at 2% stable, golden-set +7%, error-budget steady. request 20% advance.
oncall_sre: approve to 20% if next 10m stays within abort.
ops_lead: notifying a small set of impacted customers with a mitigation note (no downtime expected).
hank: moving to 20% now.
deploybot: advancing deploy to 20%.
hank: 14m into 20%: metrics look good, p99 down ~30% vs baseline, no spike in 5xxs. recommend full rollout.
oncall_sre: hold for another 5m to confirm golden-set remains stable; if stable, approve full.
hank: acknowledged.
oncall_sre: 5m clear, golden-set stable. approve 100% rollout.
deploybot: progressing to 100% -> dr-1785556789-f complete status=success slices=100%.
devrel: changelog entry posted and hotfix tagged expedited-critical. billing and release board updated.
ops_lead: follow-ups: open RCA ticket focusing on quantization path for long sequences, add a canary golden-set automation for model rollouts, and schedule regression tests for >1500 token workloads.
hank: rollback one-liner if needed:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.5-quant && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/embed-service
```
celeste: thanks all 44d will file RCA and link here when available. closing thread.
